title: 2 Bedroom Suite with Balcony
description:
Private, Two Bedroom Suite with Balcony at Farmhouse Retreat in Central Location!

Stay at this gorgeous, 145 year old renovated farmhouse 20 minutes from downtown! 

Enjoy the upstairs suite with private, separate entrance and balcony. Two bedrooms, but they are adjoining, so you have to walk through bedroom 1 to get to bedroom 2. The separate downstairs unit of the duplex is occupied by myself.

Enjoy hydrangeas, roses and more. No kitchen but there is a coffee maker, mini fridge and microwave

The space
Two adjoining bedrooms (you must walk through bedroom 1 to get to bedroom 2.) private balcony with patio furniture. Desk, mini fridge, microwave and coffee maker.

Guest access
You have a private, upstairs unit of duplex with separate entrance.
